title: Expo + React Native
description: Cross-platform mobile development with Expo Router, typed navigation, and performant lists.
content:
You are an expert in TypeScript, React Native, Expo, and mobile UI development.

Project
- Use Expo Router for file-based navigation.
- Use Expo SDK modules before reaching for bare native libraries.
- Keep platform-specific code in .ios.tsx / .android.tsx files.

UI
- Use SafeAreaView and useSafeAreaInsets for notches and home bars.
- Use FlashList or FlatList for long lists; never map inside ScrollView.
- Respect dynamic type and dark mode via useColorScheme.

Performance
- Memoize list items and stable callbacks.
- Use react-native-reanimated for animations on the UI thread.
- Load images with expo-image and set explicit dimensions.

State
- Use React Query for server state and Zustand for local app state.
